messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you sell your acoustic guitar quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace worn strings if needed and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Document Condition** | Take high‑resolution photos from multiple angles (body, neck, headstock, fretboard, electronics if any). Note any scratches, dents, or repairs. | Transparency builds trust with buyers and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. Note price ranges for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid over‑ or under‑pricing. | | **4. Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
• Brand, model, year, and serial number
• Condition summary (new, like new, good, fair)
• Included accessories (case, strap, picks, extra strings)
• Any modifications or repairs
• Reason for selling | A detailed description reduces back‑and‑forth questions and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Platforms** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, global reach.
• **eBay** – auction or fixed price, large audience.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music shops** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price to allow room for negotiation. Use the “price” field on Reverb/eBay and “asking price” on Craigslist/Facebook. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point gives you flexibility. | | **7. Offer Shipping (if online)** | Provide clear shipping options:
• Buyer pays for shipping (most common).
• Offer a “pick‑up only” option for local buyers.
• Use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) and insure the package. | Shipping details reduce buyer hesitation and protect you from loss/damage. | | **8. Screen Potential Buyers** | Ask questions about their experience level, intended use, and how they plan to transport the guitar. Verify payment methods (PayPal, Venmo, bank transfer). | Helps avoid scams and ensures the buyer is serious. | | **9. Negotiate & Finalize** | Be polite but firm. If a buyer offers less than your minimum, politely decline or counter‑offer. Once agreed, send a written confirmation (email or platform message). | Keeps the transaction professional and documented. | | **10. Complete the Sale** | • If shipping: package securely (foam, bubble wrap, sturdy box).
• If local: meet in a safe, public place (coffee shop, police station).
• Transfer ownership paperwork if required (some states need a bill of sale). | Proper hand‑over protects both parties and satisfies legal requirements. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: Spring and summer are peak times for instrument sales (students, touring musicians). - **Safety**: For in‑person meetings, bring a friend or meet in a public area. - **Negotiation**: Keep your lowest acceptable price in mind; don’t reveal it until you’re ready to accept an offer. - **Extras**: Offering a spare case or a set of strings can sweeten the deal. - **Legal**: Keep a copy of the sale agreement and any receipts for tax purposes. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2015 - Condition: Excellent (no visible scratches, fretboard in good shape) - Included: Original case, strap, 2 sets of strings, pick - Notes: Recently tuned, no repairs needed Price: $350 (fixed) Shipping: Buyer pays, insured via UPS Ground Contact: [Your email] or message through Reverb ``` Follow these steps, and you’ll be well on your way to a smooth, profitable sale. Good luck!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can give steps: research market value, clean and maintain, take good photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, or donation. Provide tips for negotiation. Also mention legal aspects. Provide a concise guide. No function call needed.
